info.title: SynthPanel REST API
info.summary: The v1 HTTP surface implemented by crates/synthpanel-web/src/api/mod.rs
info.description:
All `/api/v1` paths below are registered in `crates/synthpanel-web/src/api/mod.rs`. Responses are JSON objects proxied from the privileged core unless stated otherwise; where the core returns an untyped value, the schema is deliberately generic. Fields with a `default` in a request schema are optional in the handler (serde defaults). Paths outside that router (`/healthz`, the embedded UI and its static assets) are not listed. 

Authentication: a browser sends the `synthpanel_session` cookie; scripts send `Authorization: Bearer sp_<prefix>_<secret>`. A Bearer token takes precedence over the cookie and is exempt from CSRF. Browser mutations (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) must echo the `synthpanel_csrf` cookie in the `x-csrf-token` header; the two public auth paths and Bearer requests are exempt. Roles: admin (terminal, users, security, alerts, settings, panel, update), operator (sites, databases, files, backups, cron, deployments; read-only elsewhere), user (read-only plus sites assigned to them). API-key scopes are `read`, `write` and `admin`. The `/api/v1/auth/sessions*` endpoints reject Bearer keys even though their policy is read-only. Note: `POST`/`DELETE /api/v1/api-keys` are currently classified as read-scope operations by `authz.rs`; the `x-api-key-scope` extensions reflect the implementation, not a recommendation. 

This document is generated from the current handlers; where a CloudPanel-parity feature is only wired through the CLI and core, the endpoint may still be incomplete in the UI. See `docs/roadmap.md` for per-feature status.

cookieAuth.name: synthpanel_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session. Mutating requests also need `x-csrf-token` matching the `synthpanel_csrf` cookie.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped API key. CSRF is not applied to Bearer requests.

JsonValue.description: A JSON value returned by the core IPC method. The handlers proxy these objects without a fixed shape.

User.description: A user record. Password hashes and TOTP secrets are stripped by the handler.

oneOf.description: Session established; Set-Cookie sends synthpanel_session and synthpanel_csrf.
Password accepted, a TOTP code is still required.

PasswordRequest.description: Required by the extractor. Only checked by /2fa/setup when 2FA is already enabled, and by /2fa/disable.

maintenance_mode.description: Stored and editable; the panel does not enforce it yet.

SettingsPatch.description: Only these keys are accepted; an empty object or an unknown key returns 400.

UserUpdate.description: All fields are optional. A caller may not change its own role/status, and the last active admin may not be demoted or disabled.

domain.description: A hostname; trimmed and lowercased, max 253 characters.

document_root.description: Defaults to the panel's generated root.

template.description: Default template applied by the handler.

directives.description: Custom Nginx directives, validated before apply.

overrides.description: php.ini overrides object; defaults to an empty object.

php_version.description: A value or null; null clears the selection.

UpdateSiteRequest.description: Every field is optional; only supplied keys are forwarded to the core.

basic_auth_password.description: Omit to keep the current password.

SiteSecurityRequest.description: All fields are optional: the handler applies serde defaults, so an empty object resets to these defaults.

data.description: Base64-encoded dump; raw SQL text is accepted by the core as well.

RunBackupRequest.description: All fields optional; unset values are forwarded as null and defaulted by the core.

scope.description: Defaults to the handler's configured scope.

scopes.description: Scope list or JSON value; defaults to null when omitted.

config.description: Channel configuration object; defaults to null.

TerminalOpenRequest.description: All fields optional; the handler/core supplies defaults.

TerminalWriteRequest.description: Both fields optional; provide one of them.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed for this role/scope, or invalid CSRF token (403)
